_comment: ORGANISER ONLY. Verified alternative routes from the base paper to the target. Every supporting edge is VERIFIED in master_graph.json and is part of the scoring reference set, so teams that follow any of these routes earn credit.

paths.label: Direct tomography-to-phylogenetics route
paths.notes: Shortest and most explicit route: Ni & Tatikonda run neighbor-joining (Alg. 1, p.13) and derive rooted NJ (Alg. 2, p.15).

paths.label: Machine-learning (latent tree) route
paths.notes: Castro et al.'s review names the phylogenetics connection in its abstract. Choi et al. link phylogenetics to network tomography (p.4) and use NJ inside CLNJ. Weaker first hop: citation plus review-level framing only.

paths.label: Sample-complexity (theory) route
paths.notes: Reaches the target through the theory of how much data hidden-tree reconstruction needs (poly(log n) samples).

also_traversable_unregistered.notes: Via Duffield et al. (P12 cites P02). Verified edges exist, but the P02 hop carries no extra conceptual content. Listed for completeness.

review_process: A team may argue for a route not listed here. Its edges enter the organiser review queue with the team's evidence_reference. Once an organiser verifies them (graph.validation.promote_edge), they join the scoring reference set and the team is rescored.
